# Cncf Desktop Kubernetes Reviewer

Review Desktop Kubernetes using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Distribution category. Stands up a three-VM Kubernetes development cluster on the desktop using VirtualBox, by running a single Bash script.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
